_about: Public-domain Samuel Davies (1723-1761, Presbyterian evangelist of the Great Awakening in Virginia, later president of the College of New Jersey) for the Word Hoard: his Sermons on Important Subjects (New York: Robert Carter, 1845, 3 vols, with an essay by Albert Barnes), raw Internet Archive OCR from Princeton scans. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 5 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.

sdavies-sermons-1: Sermons on Important Subjects, vol. 1 (New York: Carter, 1845)
sdavies-sermons-2: Sermons on Important Subjects, vol. 2 (New York: Carter, 1845)
sdavies-sermons-3: Sermons on Important Subjects, vol. 3 (New York: Carter, 1845)

_alternates.sermonsdavies01..03daviiala (Philadelphi: A later edition; its vol. 1 text file returned HTTP 500 on four tries on 2026-10-02, so the shelf uses the complete 1845 set instead.
_alternates.sermonsonimporta*davi and sermonsonimpor: Other editions and scans of the same Sermons.
